title: Session reconnection
subtitle: Synthetic design example — not a claim about any product
summary: Today, closing a transport also destroys the logical session. Move session lifetime into the session store so a new transport can attach to the same session.

callouts.body: The session store owns session lifetime; the reconnect worker owns reconnection attempts.

rows: Session lifetime remains coupled to a connection
Attachment and cleanup rules need explicit ownership

steps.title: Define attachment ownership
steps.body: Specify one active transport per session and refusal of stale attachments.

steps.title: Move lifetime into the store
steps.body: Add a reconnect worker and replace the transport-local socket cache.

steps.title: Exercise disconnect and reconnect
steps.body: Verify that the same session survives and a second attachment is refused.

risks.title: Concurrent attachment
risks.body: Two transports may race to attach. The session store must accept one active transport per session and refuse the stale attachment.
